Glassware, tableware and linen hire

Tableware & Linen HireGlassware, crockery, cutlery and linen for every place setting.

Guests spend more time at the table than anywhere else. Glassware, crockery, cutlery, tablecloths, napkins and charger plates decide how that table looks and works. Plan one place setting, then multiply.

Build a place setting
Covers
Glassware, crockery, cutlery, tablecloths, runners, napkins, chargers and vases
Count by
Guests, courses and the drinks served at the table
Ask about
Washing, breakages and how items are packed for return
Pairs with
Event furniture and event décor

The place setting

Build one place setting first.

Every count follows from a single setting multiplied by your guests.

  • Start with the plates

    Decide the menu format first. A shared meal and a plated dinner of several courses need different plate and cutlery counts.

  • Add a charger if it suits the style

    Charger plates sit under the dinner plate and frame each setting. Ask your caterer whether they stay on the table during service.

  • Choose glassware by drink

    A glass for water and one for each drink served at the table is a sensible starting point.

  • Finish with linen

    Napkins, runners and tablecloths set the colour and texture of the whole table.

Glassware hire

Glassware hire, by drink.

Name the drinks you plan to serve and the hire company can suggest the shapes to match.

  • 01

    Water tumblers

    Straight-sided tumblers or stemless glasses for water at every setting.

  • 02

    Wine glasses

    Stemmed glasses for red and white wine. Some events use one all-purpose shape for both.

  • 03

    Flutes and coupes

    Flutes suit sparkling wine; coupes suit a vintage look and many cocktails.

  • 04

    Highballs and tumblers

    For spirits, mixed drinks and soft drinks at the bar.

  • 05

    Cocktail glasses

    Martini, margarita and other shapes for a cocktail menu.

  • 06

    Jugs and dispensers

    For water on the tables and self-serve drinks stations.

Linen hire

Tablecloth and linen hire: sizes, drops and colour.

Linen is sized to the table, so the table comes first.

  • Measure your tables

    Tell the hire company the table shape and size, or hire tables and linen together so they match.

  • Choose the drop

    A floor-length drop looks formal and hides table legs. A shorter drop feels relaxed and shows the table frame.

  • Runners and napkins

    Runners add colour without covering the whole table. Napkin hire lets you repeat that colour or contrast with it.

  • Cloths for tables from another company

    If the furniture comes from a different supplier, send their table sizes so the cloths fit.

  • Colour in real light

    Ask for swatches or daylight photos. Some colours read differently under warm evening lighting.

Crockery, cutlery and centrepieces

The pieces between the plate and the candle.

Crockery hire and cutlery hire usually come in matched ranges, from classic white and silver to stoneware and brushed gold.

Count each course separately: entrée, main and dessert plates, side plates for bread, and the knives, forks and spoons each course needs. Add teacups or coffee cups if hot drinks are served at the table.

Centrepiece hire and vase hire sit on the table too. Choose heights that let guests see each other, and leave space for share platters if the meal is served family style.

See event décor hire for vessels and candle holders

Before, during and after

The life of a hired table setting.

Tableware passes through several hands on the day. Agree who handles each stage.

Before

Counting and delivery

  • Count by course and by drink
  • Ask how many spares the company suggests
  • Confirm the delivery time and where crates go

On the day

Setting and clearing

  • Decide who unpacks and sets the tables
  • Check whether your caterer clears and stacks
  • Keep the empty crates somewhere dry

After

Returning it

  • Ask whether items return unwashed, rinsed or clean
  • Count breakages before collection
  • Pack each item back in its original crate

By service style

How the menu changes the count.

Talk to your caterer before you count. The way food is served decides the tableware list.

Plated dinner

Predictable counts

Each course has its own plates and cutlery, and staff clear between courses, so counts follow the menu closely.

Shared or banquet style

Serving ware joins the list

Platters, bowls and serving utensils are added, and each guest may need fewer plate changes.

Cocktail and canapés

Glassware leads

Fewer plates, more glasses and small napkins. Plan where empty glasses will go.

Quotes

What affects a tableware quote.

The unit price of a glass is only part of the total.

Pieces per setting

Each extra course or drink adds a line to every setting.

Range and finish

Coloured glass, metallic cutlery and patterned plates can sit in different price bands.

Washing

Whether washing is included, or items must come back clean.

Breakages and losses

How missing and broken items are charged.

Delivery

Delivery and collection times, including late-night pick-ups.

Minimum hire

Some companies have a minimum order for delivery.

Keep building the list

Around the table.

Tableware is ordered alongside furniture and décor more often than on its own.

  • Under the linenEvent Furniture HireDining tables and chairs
  • On the tableEvent Décor HireVessels, candle holders and signage
  • WeddingsWedding HireThe full ceremony and reception list
  • CandlelightEvent Lighting HireCandles, candelabra and lamps

Questions

Tableware and linen, answered.

Practical answers about counts, cleaning and breakages.

Do I need to wash hired tableware before returning it?

It depends on the company. Some ask for items to be scraped and rinsed; others handle all the washing. Check before the event so the clean-up is planned.

What happens if a glass breaks?

Breakages and losses are generally charged. Ask how they are counted and what each costs before you book.

Can I hire linen on its own?

Yes, many companies hire linen separately. Send the table shapes and sizes so the cloths fit.

Does my caterer supply tableware?

Some caterers and venues do. Ask what is included before hiring separately, so nothing is booked twice.

How early should tableware arrive?

Early enough to unpack and set the tables before guests arrive. Share the venue’s access times with the hire company.

Wherever the table is set, add your suburb and venue in step 3 of the brief.

Browse locations

Build your brief

Set the table in one brief.

Tell us the guest count, the menu format and the look you want. Tableware and styling professionals who suit the event can review it and respond.

There is no obligation to book.

/* ==========================================================================
   The Set Edit | design system v2 "Gallery Edit" (homepage approval build)
   Source of truth: The Set Edit Website Developer Master Brief, section 2.
   Palette: Gallery White, Onyx, Travertine, Oxide, Brushed Aluminium, Parchment.
   Type: Inter Display (Inter 4 at opsz 32) for the wordmark, headlines and
   navigation, Inter at text size for body copy, PT Mono for labels.
   Square corners, hairline rules and restrained colour: Oxide is the only accent.
   ========================================================================== */
:root{
  /* Brand palette (exact values from the brief) */
  --gallery-white:#F4F1EB;
  --onyx:#151515;
  --travertine:#CFC1B2;
  --oxide:#A6513D;
  --aluminium:#A8A8A5;
  --parchment:#E7E0D7;
  /* Derived tokens: accessibility and interaction states only */
  --card:#FBF9F5;            /* Gallery White lift for cards, panels and the form */
  --oxide-deep:#86402F;      /* Oxide text on Parchment; Oxide button hover */
  --oxide-ink:#74372A;       /* Oxide text on Travertine */
  --oxide-lift:#D7917C;      /* Oxide text on Onyx */
  --aluminium-deep:#7E7E7A;  /* control borders and diagram strokes, 3:1 on light */
  /* Text */
  --ink:#151515;
  --body:#2E2B27;
  --muted:#56504A;
  /* Rules */
  --line:#CFC1B2;
  --rule:rgba(21,21,21,.16);
  --rule-strong:rgba(21,21,21,.28);
  /* Dark surface tokens */
  --dark-heading:#F4F1EB;
  --dark-body:#E7E0D7;
  --dark-muted:#A8A8A5;
  --dark-line:rgba(244,241,235,.16);
  --dark-line-strong:rgba(244,241,235,.32);
  /* Type */
  --font-display:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --font-body:"Inter",system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI","Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif;
  --font-mono:"PT Mono",ui-monospace,"SFMono-Regular",Menlo,Consolas,monospace;
  --opsz-display:"opsz" 32;
  --fs-h1:clamp(3rem,1.6rem + 4.4vw,5.75rem);
  --fs-h2:clamp(1.75rem,1.2rem + 1.8vw,2.875rem);
  --fs-h3:.9375rem;
  --fs-lead:clamp(1.0625rem,1rem + .25vw,1.1875rem);
  --fs-body:1rem;
  --fs-small:.9375rem;
  --fs-xs:.8125rem;
  --fs-mono:.75rem;
  --track-display:.03em;
  --track-caps:.1em;
  --track-mono:.16em;
  /* Space */
  --s1:4px;--s2:8px;--s3:12px;--s4:16px;--s5:24px;--s6:32px;--s7:48px;--s8:64px;--s9:96px;
  --section-y:clamp(64px,3.5rem + 4vw,128px);
  --container:1320px;
  --gutter:clamp(16px,4vw,56px);
  --radius:0;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);
  --header-h:72px;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:calc(var(--header-h) + 16px)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--gallery-white);color:var(--body);font-family:var(--font-body);font-size:var(--fs-body);line-height:1.65;font-weight:400;font-optical-sizing:auto;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility;overflow-x:hidden}
img{max-width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
a{color:inherit}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
ul,ol{margin:0;padding:0}
h1,h2,h3,h4{margin:0;color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink));font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-weight:400}
button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit;color:inherit}
.container{width:100%;max-width:var(--container);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:var(--gutter)}
.visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0 0 0 0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.skip-link{position:absolute;left:12px;top:-60px;z-index:300;background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white);padding:12px 18px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none}
.skip-link:focus{top:12px}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--c-focus,var(--oxide));outline-offset:3px}

/* ---------- Section themes (components read these variables) ---------- */
.band{position:relative;padding-block:var(--section-y);--c-heading:var(--ink);--c-text:var(--body);--c-muted:var(--muted);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide);--c-rule:var(--rule);--c-focus:var(--oxide);color:var(--c-text)}
.band--gallery{background:var(--gallery-white)}
.band--parchment{background:var(--parchment);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-deep);--c-focus:var(--oxide-deep)}
.band--travertine{background:var(--travertine);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-ink);--c-rule:var(--rule-strong);--c-focus:var(--onyx)}
.band--onyx,.theme-dark{--c-heading:var(--dark-heading);--c-text:var(--dark-body);--c-muted:var(--dark-muted);--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-lift);--c-rule:var(--dark-line);--c-focus:var(--oxide-lift);color:var(--dark-body)}
.band--onyx{background:var(--onyx)}
.theme-dark{background:var(--onyx)}

/* ---------- Typography ---------- */
.eyebrow{display:block;margin:0 0 18px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);font-weight:400;line-height:1.5;letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-eyebrow,var(--oxide))}
.h2{font-size:var(--fs-h2);font-weight:300;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:var(--track-display);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-heading);text-wrap:balance}
.h2--sentence{text-transform:none;letter-spacing:-.012em;font-weight:300}
.card-title{font-size:var(--fs-h3);font-weight:500;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink))}
.lead{font-size:var(--fs-lead);line-height:1.62;color:var(--c-text);max-width:58ch}
.section-head{display:grid;gap:20px;align-items:end;margin-bottom:clamp(32px,4vw,56px)}
.section-head .lead{margin:0}
@media (min-width:960px){.section-head--split{grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:var(--s8)}}
.section-foot{margin-top:clamp(28px,3vw,44px)}
.section-foot--split{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px 32px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--c-rule)}
.section-foot--split p{margin:0;color:var(--c-muted);font-size:var(--fs-small)}
.edit-grid + .section-foot--split,.au-grid + .section-foot--split{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
@media (min-width:1080px){.au-grid + .section-foot--split{border-top:1px solid var(--c-rule);padding-top:24px}}

/* ---------- Buttons and links ---------- */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:12px;min-height:48px;padding:14px 24px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:400;line-height:1.35;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;text-align:center;transition:background-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease),border-color .2s var(--ease)}
.btn i{font-size:.9em;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.btn:hover i{transform:translateX(3px)}
.btn--primary{background:var(--oxide);border-color:var(--oxide);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.btn--primary:hover{background:var(--oxide-deep);border-color:var(--oxide-deep)}
.btn--ink{background:var(--onyx);border-color:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.btn--ink:hover{background:var(--oxide-deep);border-color:var(--oxide-deep)}
.btn--light{background:var(--gallery-white);border-color:var(--gallery-white);color:var(--onyx)}
.btn--light:hover{background:var(--oxide-lift);border-color:var(--oxide-lift)}
.btn--outline{background:transparent;border-color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink));color:var(--c-heading,var(--ink))}
.btn--outline:hover{background:var(--onyx);border-color:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.btn--sm{min-height:44px;padding:11px 18px;font-size:.75rem}
.link-mono{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);line-height:1.4;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-eyebrow,var(--oxide));text-decoration:none}
.link-mono .link-text{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:5px;text-decoration-color:color-mix(in srgb,currentColor 35%,transparent)}
.link-mono i{font-size:.95em;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.link-mono:hover .link-text{text-decoration-color:currentColor}
.link-mono:hover i{transform:translateX(4px)}
.link-mono:hover i.fa-arrow-down{transform:translateY(3px)}

/* ---------- Header and navigation ---------- */
.site-header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:100;background:rgba(244,241,235,.97);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);transition:box-shadow .25s var(--ease)}
.site-header.is-stuck{box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(21,21,21,.06)}
.header-inner{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:var(--s4);min-height:var(--header-h)}
.brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;min-height:44px;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;margin-right:auto}
.wordmark{font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:1.375rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap;color:inherit}
.site-nav{display:flex;align-items:center}
.nav-list{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0}
.nav-link,.nav-trigger{position:relative;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:44px;padding:10px 14px;background:none;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius);font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.75rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.nav-link::after,.nav-trigger::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:14px;right:14px;bottom:6px;height:1px;background:var(--oxide);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .25s var(--ease)}
.nav-trigger i{font-size:.625rem;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] i{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.nav-link:hover,.nav-trigger:hover,.nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"]{color:var(--oxide)}
.nav-link:hover::after,.nav-trigger:hover::after,.nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"]::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
.header-cta{flex:0 0 auto;margin-left:10px}
.nav-cta-mobile{display:none}
.nav-toggle{display:none}
.nav-panel{display:none}
.panel-title{display:block;margin:0 0 12px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide)}
.panel-links{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:0}
.panel-links a{display:flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;padding:8px 0;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none;font-size:.9375rem}
.panel-links a:hover{color:var(--oxide);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.panel-all{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:40px;margin-bottom:16px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.panel-all i{font-size:.85em;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.panel-all:hover{color:var(--oxide)}
.panel-all:hover i{transform:translateX(3px)}
.panel-note{padding:24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.panel-note .panel-note-title{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:1.125rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dark-heading)}
.panel-note p{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--dark-body)}
.panel-state-name{margin:0 0 6px}
.panel-state a.state-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.panel-state a.state-link:hover{color:var(--oxide)}

@media (min-width:1121px){
  .nav-item.has-panel{position:static}
  .nav-panel{position:absolute;left:var(--gutter);right:var(--gutter);top:100%;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-top:2px solid var(--onyx);box-shadow:0 28px 56px rgba(21,21,21,.10);padding:28px 32px 32px}
  .nav-panel::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:-24px;height:24px}
  .nav-item.is-open .nav-panel{display:block;animation:panelIn .18s var(--ease)}
  .panel-grid{display:grid;gap:36px}
  .panel-grid--hire{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.7fr 1.1fr}
  .panel-grid--hire .panel-links--two{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:32px}
  #panel-styling{left:auto;width:min(760px,calc(100% - 2 * var(--gutter)))}
  .panel-grid--styling{grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr}
  .panel-grid--locations{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
  .panel-grid--locations .panel-state + .panel-state{border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:28px}
}
@media (min-width:1121px) and (max-width:1279px){
  .wordmark{font-size:1.1875rem;letter-spacing:.16em}
  .nav-link,.nav-trigger{padding-inline:9px;letter-spacing:.08em}
  .nav-link::after,.nav-trigger::after{left:9px;right:9px}
  .header-cta{margin-left:4px}
}
@keyframes panelIn{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

@media (max-width:1120px){
  .header-cta{order:2}
  .nav-toggle{order:3;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:46px;height:46px;border:1px solid var(--onyx);border-radius:var(--radius);background:transparent;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink)}
  .nav-toggle i{font-size:1.05rem}
  .site-nav{position:fixed;inset:var(--header-h) 0 0 auto;width:min(440px,100%);background:var(--gallery-white);border-left:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:-24px 0 48px rgba(21,21,21,.12);display:block;overflow-y:auto;padding:8px var(--gutter) 40px;transform:translateX(100%);visibility:hidden;transition:transform .28s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .28s}
  .site-nav.is-open{transform:none;visibility:visible;transition:transform .28s var(--ease),visibility 0s}
  .nav-list{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0}
  .nav-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
  .nav-link,.nav-trigger{width:100%;justify-content:space-between;min-height:58px;padding:16px 2px;font-size:.8125rem}
  .nav-link::after,.nav-trigger::after{display:none}
  .nav-item.is-open .nav-panel{display:block;padding:0 2px 20px}
  .panel-grid{display:grid;gap:20px}
  .panel-note{display:none}
  .nav-cta-mobile{display:flex;width:100%;margin-top:24px}
  .panel-grid--locations{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
}
.site-header .nav-toggle{flex:0 0 auto}
@media (max-width:520px){
  .header-inner{gap:8px}
  .wordmark{font-size:.9375rem;letter-spacing:.14em}
  .site-header .header-cta{margin-left:0;padding-inline:12px;font-size:.6875rem;letter-spacing:.06em}
  .site-header .nav-toggle{width:44px;height:44px}
  .panel-grid--locations{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media (max-width:359px){
  .site-header .header-cta{display:none}
}
.nav-scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(21,21,21,.42);z-index:90;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s var(--ease),visibility 0s linear .25s}
.nav-scrim.is-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .25s var(--ease)}
body.nav-locked{overflow:hidden}

/* ---------- Hero ---------- */
.hero{background:var(--parchment);container-type:inline-size;--c-eyebrow:var(--oxide-deep);--c-focus:var(--oxide-deep)}
.hero-grid{display:grid}
.hero-panel{display:flex;align-items:center;padding:40px var(--gutter) 52px}
.hero-copy{width:100%;max-width:600px}
.hero-title{margin:0 0 26px;color:var(--ink)}
.hero-title-main{display:block;font-size:var(--fs-h1);font-weight:300;line-height:.96;letter-spacing:.025em;text-transform:uppercase}
.hero-title-sub{display:block;margin-top:22px;font-size:clamp(1.25rem,1.05rem + .7vw,1.625rem);font-weight:400;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.008em;max-width:24ch;text-wrap:balance}
.hero-lead{font-size:var(--fs-lead);line-height:1.62;color:var(--body);max-width:48ch;margin:0 0 32px}
.hero-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:14px 28px}
.hero .link-mono{color:var(--oxide-deep)}
.hero-proof{margin:36px 0 0;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule-strong);font-size:var(--fs-xs);line-height:1.6;letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--muted);max-width:52ch}
.hero-media{margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--travertine);order:-1;aspect-ratio:16/10}
.hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:58% 50%}
@media (min-width:980px){
  .hero-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,46fr) minmax(0,54fr);min-height:clamp(580px,calc(100vh - var(--header-h)),800px)}
  .hero-panel{padding:clamp(56px,5vw,96px) clamp(40px,4vw,80px) clamp(56px,5vw,96px) max(var(--gutter),calc((100cqw - var(--container)) / 2 + var(--gutter)))}
  .hero-media{order:0;aspect-ratio:auto;height:100%}
}
@media (max-width:979px){
  .hero-title-sub{max-width:30ch}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .btn{letter-spacing:.06em;padding-inline:18px}
  .hero-media{aspect-ratio:16/9}
  .hero-media img{object-position:62% 58%}
  .hero-panel{padding-top:28px;padding-bottom:44px}
  .hero-title{margin-bottom:20px}
  .hero-title-sub{margin-top:16px;max-width:none}
  .hero-lead{margin-bottom:24px}
  .hero-actions .btn{width:100%}
}

/* ---------- Occasions ---------- */
.occ-grid{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:20px}
@media (min-width:600px){.occ-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (min-width:1100px){.occ-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.occ-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.occ-media{margin:0;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;background:var(--travertine)}
.occ-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:var(--pos,50% 50%);transition:transform .6s var(--ease)}
.occ-card:hover .occ-media img{transform:scale(1.03)}
.occ-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:22px 22px 18px;flex:1}
.occ-body p{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--muted)}
.mono-links{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 22px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:4px}

/* ---------- The Elements ---------- */
.el-grid{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:14px}
@media (min-width:560px){.el-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (min-width:1040px){.el-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.el-tile{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);align-content:start;gap:6px 16px;padding:22px 22px 12px;border:1px solid var(--dark-line-strong);transition:border-color .2s var(--ease),background-color .2s var(--ease)}
.el-no{grid-row:1 / span 3;padding-top:2px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--oxide-lift)}
.el-title{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dark-heading)}
.el-items{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-xs);line-height:1.55;color:var(--dark-muted)}
.el-link{grid-column:2;justify-self:start;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;min-height:40px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dark-muted);text-decoration:none}
.el-link::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0}
.el-link i{font-size:.95em;transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.el-tile:hover{border-color:var(--oxide-lift);background:rgba(244,241,235,.04)}
.el-tile:hover .el-link{color:var(--dark-heading)}
.el-tile:hover .el-link i{transform:translateX(4px)}
.el-tile:focus-within{border-color:var(--oxide-lift)}
.el-link:focus-visible{outline:none}
.el-link:focus-visible::after{outline:2px solid var(--oxide-lift);outline-offset:3px}
.el-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px 32px;margin-top:36px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--dark-line)}
.el-foot p{margin:0;max-width:60ch;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--dark-muted)}
.el-foot-links{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 28px}

/* ---------- The Edit ---------- */
.edit-grid{list-style:none;display:grid;border-top:1px solid var(--c-rule)}
.edit-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;padding:26px 0 28px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-rule)}
.edit-no{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--c-eyebrow)}
.edit-item p{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--c-text)}
.edit-item .edit-materials{margin-top:auto;padding-top:6px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.06em;line-height:1.6;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-muted)}
@media (min-width:600px) and (max-width:1099px){
  .edit-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:0}
  .edit-item:nth-child(odd){padding-right:28px;border-right:1px solid var(--c-rule)}
  .edit-item:nth-child(even){padding-left:28px}
}
@media (min-width:1100px){
  .edit-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .edit-item{padding:28px 28px 30px}
  .edit-item:not(:nth-child(4n)){border-right:1px solid var(--c-rule)}
  .edit-item:nth-child(4n+1){padding-left:0}
  .edit-item:nth-child(4n){padding-right:0}
}

/* ---------- Styling ---------- */
.styling-grid{display:grid;gap:clamp(40px,5vw,80px);align-items:start}
@media (min-width:1000px){.styling-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.styling-copy .lead{margin:22px 0 0}
.styling-copy .styling-body{margin:14px 0 0;max-width:58ch}
.path-list{list-style:none;display:grid;margin:32px 0 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}
.path{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.path a{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:4px 24px;align-items:center;padding:20px 0;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.path-title{grid-column:1;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.path-desc{grid-column:1;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--muted)}
.path i{grid-column:2;grid-row:1 / span 2;display:grid;place-items:center;width:44px;height:44px;border:1px solid var(--onyx);color:var(--ink);transition:background-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease)}
.path a:hover .path-title{color:var(--oxide)}
.path a:hover i{background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.plan-figure{margin:0;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);padding:clamp(18px,2.4vw,32px)}
.plan-figure figcaption{margin-top:14px;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted)}
.scope-card{margin-top:20px;padding:26px 28px;background:var(--parchment)}
.scope-card .card-title{margin-bottom:14px}
.check-list{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:10px}
.check-list li{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:var(--fs-small)}
.check-mark{flex:0 0 auto;width:10px;height:10px;margin-top:6px;background:var(--oxide)}
@media (min-width:600px){.scope-card .check-list{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;column-gap:24px}}
.scope-note{margin:18px 0 0;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule-strong);font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--body)}
.scope-note strong{font-weight:600;color:var(--ink)}

/* ---------- Diagrams (decorative line drawings) ---------- */
.dg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible}
.dg *{fill:none;stroke:var(--aluminium-deep);stroke-width:1.1;vector-effect:non-scaling-stroke}
.dg .dg-wall{stroke:var(--onyx);stroke-width:1.4}
.dg .dg-thin{stroke-width:.9}
.dg .dg-dash{stroke-dasharray:4 4}
.dg .dg-flow{stroke:var(--oxide);stroke-dasharray:2 4}
.dg .dg-accent{stroke:var(--oxide);stroke-width:2}
.dg .dg-accent-fill{fill:var(--oxide);stroke:var(--oxide)}
.dg .dg-fill{fill:var(--travertine);stroke:var(--aluminium-deep)}
.dg .dg-seats rect{fill:var(--card)}
.dg text{fill:var(--muted);stroke:none;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.12em}
.dg--plan text{font-size:10px}

/* ---------- Journal ---------- */
.journal-grid{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:20px}
@media (min-width:640px){.journal-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (min-width:1100px){.journal-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.journal-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.journal-diagram{display:grid;place-items:center;aspect-ratio:16/10;padding:12px 16px;background:var(--gallery-white);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.journal-diagram .dg{max-width:280px}
.journal-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;padding:22px 22px 20px;flex:1}
.journal-body p{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--body)}
.journal-body .journal-label{margin-top:auto;padding-top:14px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide)}
.callout{display:grid;gap:28px;margin-top:clamp(48px,6vw,80px);padding:clamp(28px,4vw,56px)}
@media (min-width:980px){.callout{grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:clamp(40px,5vw,88px);align-items:end}}
.callout-title{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:clamp(1.5rem,1.1rem + 1.3vw,2.25rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1.1;letter-spacing:var(--track-display);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dark-heading)}
.callout-main p:last-child{margin:0;max-width:60ch;color:var(--dark-body)}
.callout-side{padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--dark-line-strong)}
@media (min-width:980px){.callout-side{padding:0 0 0 32px;border-top:0;border-left:1px solid var(--dark-line-strong)}}
.callout-figure{display:flex;align-items:baseline;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;margin:0 0 12px}
.callout-number{font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:clamp(3rem,2.2rem + 2.6vw,4.5rem);font-weight:300;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.01em;color:var(--dark-heading)}
.callout-figure .eyebrow{margin:0}
.callout-side p:last-child{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--dark-muted)}

/* ---------- Australia-wide pathway ---------- */
.au-grid{display:grid;border-top:1px solid var(--rule-strong)}
@media (min-width:640px){.au-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}}
@media (min-width:1080px){.au-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.au-state{padding:22px 0 24px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
@media (min-width:640px) and (max-width:1079px){.au-state:nth-child(odd){padding-right:28px;border-right:1px solid var(--rule)}.au-state:nth-child(even){padding-left:28px}}
@media (min-width:1080px){.au-state{padding:24px 28px 26px;border-bottom:0}.au-state:first-child{padding-left:0}.au-state:last-child{padding-right:0}.au-state + .au-state{border-left:1px solid var(--rule)}}
.au-abbr{margin:0 0 4px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);color:var(--oxide)}
.au-name a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:44px;font-size:1.0625rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.au-name a i{font-size:.7em;color:var(--oxide);transition:transform .2s var(--ease)}
.au-name a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:6px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.au-name a:hover i{transform:translateX(4px)}
.au-markets{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:0 18px}
.au-markets a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:40px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--body);text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px;text-underline-offset:5px;text-decoration-color:var(--travertine)}
.au-markets a:hover{color:var(--oxide);text-decoration-color:currentColor}

/* ---------- FAQ ---------- */
.faq-grid{display:grid;gap:clamp(28px,4vw,72px);align-items:start}
@media (min-width:980px){.faq-grid{grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.2fr}.faq-intro{position:sticky;top:calc(var(--header-h) + 32px)}}
.faq-intro .lead{margin:20px 0 14px}
.faq-list{border-top:1px solid var(--rule-strong)}
.faq-item{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-strong)}
.faq-item summary{list-style:none;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;min-height:64px;padding:18px 0;cursor:pointer}
.faq-item summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq-q{font-size:1.0625rem;font-weight:500;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.005em;color:var(--ink)}
.faq-icon{flex:0 0 auto;display:grid;place-items:center;width:34px;height:34px;border:1px solid var(--onyx);color:var(--ink);font-size:.75rem;transition:transform .2s var(--ease),background-color .2s var(--ease),color .2s var(--ease)}
.faq-item[open] .faq-icon{transform:rotate(45deg);background:var(--onyx);color:var(--gallery-white)}
.faq-item summary:hover .faq-q{color:var(--oxide-deep)}
.faq-answer{padding:0 58px 22px 0;color:var(--body)}
.faq-answer p:last-child{margin-bottom:0}

/* ---------- Build your brief (closing conversion) ---------- */
.brief-grid{display:grid;gap:clamp(36px,5vw,80px);align-items:start}
@media (min-width:1000px){.brief-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
.tl-line{display:block}
.brief-head{margin-bottom:clamp(36px,4.5vw,64px);padding-bottom:clamp(28px,3vw,40px);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-strong)}
.brief-tagline{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:clamp(1.75rem,.95rem + 3.6vw,4.75rem);font-weight:300;line-height:.98;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);text-wrap:balance}
.brief-h2{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:clamp(1.0625rem,1rem + .35vw,1.3125rem);font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.brief-intro .lead{color:var(--body);margin:0}
.brief-list-title{margin:32px 0 0;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide-ink)}
.brief-list{list-style:none;margin-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule-strong)}
.brief-list li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr);gap:4px 12px;padding:16px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule-strong)}
.brief-no{font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--oxide-ink);padding-top:3px}
.brief-part{margin:0 0 4px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.brief-list li p:last-child{margin:0;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--body)}
.form-card{background:var(--card);padding:clamp(24px,3vw,44px);border-top:2px solid var(--onyx);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(21,21,21,.10)}
.form-title{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:var(--track-display);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}
.form-sub{margin:0 0 24px;color:var(--muted);font-size:var(--fs-small)}
.form-grid{display:grid;gap:18px}
@media (min-width:560px){.form-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.form-field--full{grid-column:1 / -1}}
.form-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;min-width:0}
.form-field label{font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;color:var(--ink)}
.form-field .req,.form-sub .req{color:var(--oxide)}
.form-field input,.form-field select,.form-field textarea{width:100%;min-height:50px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--aluminium-deep);border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--gallery-white);color:var(--ink);font-size:1rem;transition:border-color .2s var(--ease),box-shadow .2s var(--ease),background-color .2s var(--ease)}
.form-field textarea{min-height:128px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.5}
.form-field select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--onyx) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--onyx) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:calc(100% - 20px) 55%,calc(100% - 15px) 55%;background-size:5px 5px,5px 5px;background-repeat:no-repeat;padding-right:40px}
.form-field input::placeholder,.form-field textarea::placeholder{color:#6B645C}
.form-field input:hover,.form-field select:hover,.form-field textarea:hover{border-color:var(--onyx)}
.form-field input:focus,.form-field select:focus,.form-field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--onyx);background-color:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--onyx)}
.form-field input:focus-visible,.form-field select:focus-visible,.form-field textarea:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--oxide);outline-offset:2px}
.form-field input:user-invalid,.form-field select:user-invalid,.form-field textarea:user-invalid{border-color:#A3261E;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #A3261E}
.form-hint{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--muted)}
.form-disclosure{margin:24px 0 0;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--parchment);border-left:2px solid var(--oxide);font-size:var(--fs-xs);line-height:1.6;color:var(--body)}
.form-submit{margin-top:18px;width:100%;min-height:56px}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
.site-footer{padding:clamp(56px,6vw,96px) 0 28px}
.footer-top{display:grid;gap:40px}
@media (min-width:1080px){.footer-top{grid-template-columns:1.35fr repeat(4,.8fr);gap:40px}}
@media (min-width:360px) and (max-width:1079px){.footer-top{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:24px}.footer-brand{grid-column:1 / -1}}
.footer-brand .brand{color:var(--dark-heading)}
.footer-brand .wordmark{font-size:1.75rem}
.footer-tag{margin:10px 0 26px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide-lift)}
.footer-tagline{margin:0 0 10px;padding-top:22px;border-top:1px solid var(--dark-line);font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:1.0625rem;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:var(--track-caps);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dark-heading)}
.footer-desc{margin:0 0 24px;max-width:38ch;font-size:var(--fs-small);color:var(--dark-muted)}
.footer-col h2{margin:0 0 14px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide-lift)}
.footer-col ul{list-style:none;display:grid;gap:0}
.footer-col a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:36px;color:var(--dark-body);text-decoration:none;font-size:var(--fs-small)}
.footer-col a:hover{color:var(--dark-heading);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.footer-bottom{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px 24px;margin-top:56px;padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--dark-line);font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--dark-muted)}
.footer-bottom p{margin:0}
.credit{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.credit img{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:6px}
.credit b{color:var(--dark-heading);font-weight:400}

/* ---------- Build Your Brief: closing introduction ---------- */
.brief-start{margin-top:32px;padding:clamp(22px,2.6vw,34px);background:var(--card);border-top:2px solid var(--onyx);box-shadow:0 30px 60px rgba(21,21,21,.10);--c-focus:var(--oxide)}
.brief-start-k{margin:0 0 10px;font-family:var(--font-display);font-variation-settings:var(--opsz-display);font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:300;line-height:1.2;letter-spacing:var(--track-display);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink)}

.ld-list a{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-rule);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.ld-list a:hover .ld-name{color:var(--oxide-deep);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.ld-name{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.ld-kind{flex:none;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:.625rem;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-muted)}
.si .si-more a{justify-content:flex-start;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--oxide-deep)}
.dest-grid{display:grid;gap:0;border-top:2px solid var(--onyx)}
@media (min-width:760px){.dest-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));column-gap:clamp(24px,3vw,48px)}}
@media (min-width:1200px){.dest-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}}
.dest-col{padding:20px 0 8px}
.dest-col > *{min-width:0}
.dest-col h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-family:var(--font-mono);font-size:var(--fs-mono);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:var(--track-mono);text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--c-eyebrow)}
.dest-col ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.dest-col li a{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--c-rule);color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}
.dest-col li a .dn{font-size:1rem;font-weight:500}
.dest-col li a .dd{font-size:var(--fs-xs);color:var(--c-muted)}
.dest-col li a:hover .dn{color:var(--oxide-deep);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px;text-decoration-thickness:1px}
.localities--near li span{white-space:nowrap}
@media (min-width:1100px){.localities--near{columns:3}}
.svc .svc-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;min-height:24px;color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.svc .svc-link::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0}
.svc .svc-link:focus-visible{outline:none}
.svc--lead:hover h3{color:var(--oxide-deep)}
